title: SAT-ACT Score Converter
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Convert between SAT totals and ACT composites with the official concordance, and place the converted score in a college's middle 50% range.

learningObjectives: Students will use the SAT-ACT concordance to convert a score from one test to the other and place the result within a college's middle 50% range.
prerequisites: Chapter 6: The SAT and ACT Question

controls: College range low and high inputs

keyQuestions: Why is the ACT scale uneven when it's drawn above the SAT scale?
Why shouldn't you treat a one-point ACT difference as meaningful?
When would you need to convert a score at all?
commonMisconceptions: Concordance gives an exact equivalent score.
An SAT score can be converted to the ACT by simple division.
assessmentOpportunities: Students convert a score in both directions and correctly place it inside or outside a college's range.
